run_comms_benchmark: run the PARAM collective communications benchmark with configurable collective ops, sizes, and data types
run_pt2pt_benchmark: run point-to-point latency and bandwidth tests using ping, ping-pong, unidirectional, and bidirectional patterns
run_cuda_graph_bench: run collective benchmark using CUDA graph capture and replay for reduced launch overhead
init_backend: initialize a PyTorch distributed, TorchComms, or TPU backend with bootstrap info and comms parameters
gen_multi_comm_groups: generate multiple communication process groups by distributing ranks across specified number of groups
